title: Dew
summary: DEW, noun [G. To thaw.] The water or moisture collected or deposited on or near the surface of the earth, during the night, by the escape of the heat which held the water in solution. DEW, verb intran

inlines.v: DEW, noun [G. To thaw.] The water or moisture collected or deposited on or near the surface of the earth, during the night, by the escape of the heat which held the water in solution. DEW, verb intransitive To wet with dew; to moisten.
